When enabled, adds a button (Skull Icon) to the title bar of the Main Window to 'Call Wipe' for the current Encounter and end it immediately.
Settings_CustomBPSRExecutableName_Desc: The executable file name of the game to listen to. Ex: BPSR_STEAM
Settings_UseDatabaseForEncounterHistory_: When enabled, all encounter data is saved into a local database file (ZDatabase.db) to reduce memory usage and allow viewing between ZDPS sessions. Applies after restarting ZDPS.
Settings_DatabaseEncounterHistoryRetenti: How long to keep previous Encounter History data for. When not set to Keep Forever, expired data is automatically deleted on application close.
Settings_SkipSavingEncountersWithNoComba: When enabled, Encounters that have no combat data (such as damage events) will not be saved to the database.
Settings_LimitEncounterBuffTrackingInOpe: When enabled, buffs are limited to only the latest 100 per entity instead of being limitless. This setting is not retroactive.
Settings_SkipSkillSnapshotSavingInOpenWo:
When enabled, Skill Snapshots are no longer stored whenever a Skill Event occurs. Snapshots makes it possible to view Skill Snapshots (Instances) in the Entity Inspector. They also allow Database Migrations to occur without losing data.
Enabling this setting can help save a lot of memory while in the Open World.
Note: By default your current 'Map' is considered to be the 'Open World' before your first Map Change just after launching ZDPS even if you're not in the Open World.
Settings_AllowEncounterSavingPausingInOp:
When enabled, a button is added to the top of the Main Window that allows the current Encounter to not be saved to the Database.
This is only available while in the Open World and will automatically disable when map changing. Benchmarking and Manual New Encounter creation will be disabled while Paused.
Note: At least one map change is required before the button will appear after starting ZDPS.
Settings_PersistEncounterSavingPauseStat: When enabled, the Encounter Saving Pause state will be remembered even after changing maps. However, the state will not persist between ZDPS sessions.
Settings_MinimalProcessingWhileEncounter: When enabled, while Encounter Saving is Paused, DPS and other metrics will not be calculated. Only the minimum amount of data (Attributes) will be processed.
Settings_NormalizeMeterContributionBars_:
When enabled, the bars for each player in a meter will be based on the top player, not the overall contribution.
This means the top player is always considered the '100%%' amount.
Settings_UseShortWidthNumberFormatting_D: When enabled, uses shorter width number formats when values over 1000 would otherwise be shown.
Settings_UseAutomaticWipeDetection_Desc: When enabled, ZDPS will attempt to detect party wipes against bosses and start a new encounter automatically.
Settings_UseLegacyWipeDetection_Desc:
When enabled, uses the old legacy methods for detecting wipes.
You probably want this Disabled.
Settings_SkipTeleportStateCheckInAutomat:
When enabled, the 'Teleport' Player State requirement in Automatic Wipe Detection is not performed.
You probably want this Disabled.
Settings_DisableWipeRecalculationOverwri: When enabled, the new Wipe Recalcuation logic will be Disabled and the original method will be used (if 'Use Automatic Wipe Detection' is still Enabled).
Settings_SplitEncountersOnNewPhases_Desc:
When enabled, encounters are automatically split across phase changes. This allows bosses to be split from the rest of a dungeon. It also splits raid boss phases.
This probably should be Enabled.
Settings_DisplayActivePerSecondValuesInM:
When enabled, the Damage, Healing, and Taken Per Second value shown in the Meters will have the 'Active' Per Second value, shown in square brackets, in addition to the normal 'Encounter Per Second' value. This means it is recalculated every second while taking down time and late starts into account instead of ignoring down time and calculating based on when the first damage event in the Encounter was dealt.
Note: Both values are accurate, they are just two different metrics.
Settings_IncludeHealEventsOutsideOfComba:
When enabled, Healing events that occur outside of an Active Encounter Combat section will still be included in the calculations.
This means if a player performs healing before a boss is pulled, the Encounter will be considered started before attacks began in the fight.
Settings_ShowClassIconsInMeters_Desc: When enabled, class icons will be shown next to players in the meters.
Settings_ColorClassIconsByRoleType_Desc: When enabled, class icons shown in meters will be colored by their role instead of all being white.
Settings_ShowSkillIconsInDetails_Desc: When enabled, skill icons will be displayed, when possible, in the details panel next to skill names.
Settings_OnlyShowDamageContributorsInMet: When enabled, only players who have dealt damage will show in the DPS meter.
Settings_OnlyShowPartyMembersInMeters_De: When enabled, only players who are in the current party will show in the DPS meter.
Settings_ShowAbilityScoreInMeters_Desc: When enabled, the Ability Score for players will be shown in the meters.
Settings_ShowSeasonStrengthInMeters_Desc: When enabled, the Season Strength for players will be shown in the meters.
Settings_ShowSubProfessionNameInMeters_D: When enabled, allows showing the detected Sub Profession name in the meters. If no Sub Profession is detected, just the base class name is shown. If no base class is found, 'Unknown' is shown.
Settings_ShowPlayerSummonsInNPCTakenMete:
When enabled, Summons (such as Battle Imagine entities or specific skill entities) will be shown in the NPC Taken Meter.
Note: This does not impact any data recording or Entity Inspector data.
Settings_ShowPlayerImaginesInMeters_Desc: When enabled, shows the currently equipped imagines for players in the DPS Meter UI.
Settings_AllowGamepadNavigationInputInZD:
When enabled, gamepad input can navigate and control the ZDPS windows.
Note: Gamepad input may control the windows even without them specifically in focus.
Settings_KeepPastEncounterInMeterUIUntil:
When enabled, the previous Encounter will remain in the Meter UI until damage has been dealt in the current Encounter.
The Meter UI will still swap to the current Encounter on Battle change events (these are generally Map changes).
Settings_ShowChannelLineNumberInStatus_D: When enabled, shows the current Channel Line number in the Status bar of the Main Window.
Settings_SaveEncounterReportToFile_Desc: When enabled, writes a report file to the Reports folder located next to ZDPS.
Settings_ReportFileRetentionPolicy_Desc: How long to keep locally saved Report files for. When not set to Keep Forever, expired data is automatically deleted on application close.
Settings_MinimumPlayerCountToCreateRepor: The number of players required in an Encounter to create a report for. This applies to both local saving and Webhook sending.
Settings_AlwaysCreateReportAtDungeonEnd_:
When enabled, Reports are created at the end of a Dungeon if one was not created already.
If this is disabled Reports may not be created if a Dungeon did not end with a boss fight.
Settings_WebhookMode_Desc:
Select the type of Webhook Mode you want to use for sending ZDPS Reports.
'Discord Deduplication' is recommended if other users may be sending the same Encounter Report to the same Discord Channel at the same time to avoid duplicate messages.
Settings_SendEncounterReportsToDiscordDe: When enabled, sends an Encounter Report to the given {0} server.
Settings_DeduplicationServerURL_Desc: The Discord Deduplication Server URL to prevent duplicate reports with.
Settings_WebhookURL_Discord_Desc: The Discord Webhook URL to send reports to.
Settings_WebhookURL_Custom_Desc: The Custom URL to send reports to.
Settings_BPTimer_Enabled_Desc: When enabled, allows sending reports back to BPTimer.com.
Settings_IncludeOwnCharacterDataInReport: When enabled, your Character UID will be included in the reported data.
Settings_BPTimerFieldBossHPReports_Desc: When enabled, reports Field Boss (and Magical Creature) HP data back to BPTimer.com.
EventTracker_LayoutSizeConstraints_AutoS: Automatically adjusts window size to fit all contents.
EventTracker_LayoutSizeConstraints_Fixed: User defines width and height and anything outside is clipped.
User defines width anything outside is clipped, while height automatically adjusts.
EventTracker_Special_TrackAllBuffs_Desc1: If this is Enabled, the First Tracker in this Container will be used for the settings of all Buffs that get automatically tracked.
EventTracker_Special_TrackAllBuffs_Desc2: Any Buff selected within the Tracker will be ignored. Additionally, the Tracker Type MUST be set to Buff.
EventTracker_Special_TrackAllSkills_Desc: If this is Enabled, the First Tracker in this Container will be used for the settings of all Skills that get automatically tracked.
Any Skill selected within the Tracker will be ignored. Additionally, the Tracker Type MUST be set to Skill.
EventTracker_Settings_ShowEditModePlaceh: Attempts to add Placeholder entries for Trackers while in Edit Mode to help with visualizing them.
EventTracker_Settings_HideContainersWhen: Hide Containers When Game Not Focused
Automatically hides all Containers when the game isn't in focus regardless of Container and Tracker settings.
EventTracker_Settings_KeepContainersWhen: Having a ZDPS window in focus will prevent the Containers from being automatically hidden due to the game no longer being in focus.

Containers will only be visible when the ZDPS Meter window is actively pinned as top most.
This is not compatible with the other Container Hiding settings.
Does not apply while in Edit Mode.
EventTracker_Settings_ContainersAlwaysIg: Containers Always Ignore Input (Excluding Edit Mode)

All input/mouse events will be ignored for Containers unless in Edit Mode.
Otherwise, 'Pinned Window Clickthrough' (Mouse Passthrough) must be toggled on via Hotkey Keybind in Settings.

Settings_MeterSettings_NpcTakenShowHpDat: When enabled, adds Current HP, Max HP, and HP Percent to each entry in the NPC Taken Meter.
Settings_MeterSettings_NpcTakenHideMaxHp: When enabled, removes the Max HP value shown.

Settings_ResetMainWindowSize_Desc: Resets the Main Window back to the original size.

Resets the Raid Manager Cooldown Tracker window back to the original size.
Settings_ResetEntityCacheViewerSize_Desc: Resets the Entity Cache Viewer window back to the original size.
Settings_ResetBPTimerSpawnTrackerSize_De: Resets the BPTimer Spawn Tracker window back to the original size.
Settings_LowPerformanceMode_Desc: When enabled, will force ZDPS to run at a lower rate, potentially causing stuttering UI when moving windows. Only turn this on if you experience Very High CPU usage from ZDPS.
Settings_ZDPSRefreshRate_Desc1: Set the UI refresh rate of ZDPS. Setting this below 55hz will likely cause UI stuttering. Changes to this setting are applied and saved in real-time.
Settings_ZDPSRefreshRate_Desc2: Note: Setting this as close to 60hz as possible is recommended for all users.
Settings_EnableGDIBackBufferCopyCompatib: Enable GDI Back Buffer Copy Compatibility:
When enabled, Screen Recording programs, like OBS, can perform 'Window Captures' on ZDPS using the (Default) 'BitBlt Capture Method'.
Note: This uses more GPU resources to perform. If this is disabled, 'Desktop Captures' and the 'Window Capture Method' labeled 'Windows 10/11' will still function without issue.
Note: This setting requires a ZDPS restart to fully take effect.

Settings_Dev_WriteDebugLogToFile_Desc: When enabled, writes a debug log for ZDPS (ZDPS_log.txt). Applies after restarting ZDPS.
Settings_Dev_AggressiveExceptionDebugLog: When enabled, captures more exception data for when systems break or ZDPS crashes. Applies after restarting ZDPS.

Note: This has a chance to make ZDPS run slower.
Only turn this on when you encounter broken systems or crashes. Reproduce the issue to have a more useful ZDPS_log.txt and then turn off this setting.

Settings_PlayNotificationSoundOnMatchmak: When enabled, play a notification sound alert when the matchmaker finds players and is waiting for you to accept.
Settings_MatchmakeNotificationSoundPath_:
File path to a custom sound file to play when the matchmake notification occurs.
A default sound will be used if none is set or the file is invalid.
Note: Only MP3 and WAV are supported formats.
Settings_LoopNotificationSoundOnMatchmak: When enabled, the notification sound will loop until you accept the queue pop or it is canceled.
Settings_MatchmakeNotificationVolumeLeve: Volume scale of the played back notification sound. 100%% is the normal sound level of the audio file. Values above 100%% may not always appear louder. If you need a louder sound, please edit your file in an external program to increase loudness.
Settings_PlayNotificationSoundOnReadyChe: Play Notification Sound On Ready Check:
When enabled, play a notification sound alert when a party ready check is performed and is waiting for you to accept.
Settings_ReadyCheckNotificationSoundPath:
File path to a custom sound file to play when the ready check notification occurs.
A default sound will be used if none is set or the file is invalid.
Note: Only MP3 and WAV are supported formats.
Settings_LoopNotificationSoundOnReadyChe: Loop Notification Sound On Ready Check:
When enabled, the notification sound will loop until you respond to the ready check.
Settings_ReadyCheckNotificationVolumeLev: Volume scale of the played back notification sound.
